question.:question/problem: Consider the vector field $F=⟨x y z^{2},\,- 3 x e^{y},\,- y z^{3}⟩.$ Find $\text{div}\,F.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $F=P\,i+Q\,j+R\,k$ is a vector field on ${R}^{3}$ and the partial derivatives of the components of $F$ all exist, then the divergence of $F$ is the scalar field given by

$$
\text{div}\,F=∇\cdot F=\frac{∂P}{∂x}+\frac{∂Q}{∂y}+\frac{∂R}{∂z}.
$$

  

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\cdot F & =\frac{∂P}{∂x}+\frac{∂Q}{∂y}+\frac{∂R}{∂z} \\ & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(x y z^{2})+\frac{∂}{∂y}(- 3 x e^{y})+\frac{∂}{∂z}(- y z^{3}) \\ & =(y z^{2})+(- 3 x e^{y})+(- 3 y z^{2}) \\ & =- 3 x e^{y} - 2 y z^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:
If $F=P\,i+Q\,j+R\,k$ is a vector field on ${R}^{3}$ and the partial derivatives of the components of $F$ all exist, then the divergence of $F$ is the scalar field given by

$$
\text{div}\,F=∇\cdot F=\frac{∂P}{∂x}+\frac{∂Q}{∂y}+\frac{∂R}{∂z}.
$$

  

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\cdot F & =\frac{∂P}{∂x}+\frac{∂Q}{∂y}+\frac{∂R}{∂z} \\ & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(- 3 x^{2} e^{- 3 x y})+\frac{∂}{∂y}(y e^{- y z})+\frac{∂}{∂z}(z \left(x + y z\right)^{2}) \\ & =(9 x^{2} y e^{- 3 x y} - 6 x e^{- 3 x y})+(- y z e^{- y z} + e^{- y z})+(2 y z \left(x + y z\right) + \left(x + y z\right)^{2}) \\ & =9 x^{2} y e^{- 3 x y} + x^{2} + 4 x y z - 6 x e^{- 3 x y} + 3 y^{2} z^{2} - y z e^{- y z} + e^{- y z}.\end{aligned}
$$

If $F=P\,i+Q\,j+R\,k$ is a vector field on ${R}^{3}$ and the partial derivatives of the components of $F$ all exist, then the divergence of $F$ is the scalar field given by

$$
\text{div}\,F=∇\cdot F=\frac{∂P}{∂x}+\frac{∂Q}{∂y}+\frac{∂R}{∂z}.
$$

  

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\cdot F & =\frac{∂P}{∂x}+\frac{∂Q}{∂y}+\frac{∂R}{∂z} \\ & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(2 x^{2} e^{3 x y})+\frac{∂}{∂y}(y e^{3 y z})+\frac{∂}{∂z}(z \left(x + y z\right)^{2}) \\ & =(6 x^{2} y e^{3 x y} + 4 x e^{3 x y})+(3 y z e^{3 y z} + e^{3 y z})+(2 y z \left(x + y z\right) + \left(x + y z\right)^{2}) \\ & =6 x^{2} y e^{3 x y} + x^{2} + 4 x y z + 4 x e^{3 x y} + 3 y^{2} z^{2} + 3 y z e^{3 y z} + e^{3 y z}.\end{aligned}
$$

:answer-field/choices.:answer/value: 6 x^{2} y e^{3 x y} + x^{2} + 4 x y z + 4 x e^{3 x y} + 3 y^{2} z^{2} - 2 y z \left(x + y z\right) + 3 y z e^{3 y z} - \left(x + y z\right)^{2} + e^{3 y z}
